stepTitle: Predictions that are closer to their true target value are sometimes penalized more than predictions that are farther from their true target value.
stepBody: (d) Consider the loss function Mean Cubed Error: $$\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}**{n}(y_i-\hat{y}_i)**{3}.$$ Which of the following statements are true for this loss function when used for a linear model? Select all that apply.
